notes.title: Shotgun Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys! I'm gonna start updating this game again from now on. I hope you enjoy this new update i brought to you guys.



New shotgun weapon in sandbox mode and defense mode

Fixed bug where you kept shooting bullets on yourself especially at low framerates

Fixed bug where sometimes in survival mode level 2 enemies wouldn't come out of their spawns

notes.title: Patch 2/18/2025
notes.notes:
Working on something crazy ;)

- Fixed bug that made enemies in wave mode not detect you and stay in their spawns

notes.title: Patch 2/11/2025
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that have been here for some time

-Fixed issue where you would shoot yourself when moving at high speed or low fps.
-Fixed a bug that made the boss disappear and made level 6 unbeatable.

notes.title: Patch 2 2/8/2025
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug which made level 5 unbeatable. 
- Fixed a bug in level 6 which made the enemies walk trough objects.

notes.title: Patch 2/8/2025
notes.notes:
Very small patch.

- Added new arena level to sandbox where u can make specific enemies fight eachother
- Fixed issue on level 4 where enemies would instantly run at you trough the door

notes.title: Defense Mode Update!
notes.notes:
This update comes with a bunch of new content including:

- A new gamemode
- Friendly fighter npc
- Friendly sniper npc
- NPC AI rework
- Added muzzle flashes to the npc's
- New achievement
- New Npc's in sandbox

I really hope you guys enjoy this new update!

notes.title: Patch 12/20/2024
notes.notes:
- Brought back a invisible back button in the main menu
- Added ambience to the dropper levels so its not that silent anymore
- Buffed dropper level 2 and 3 so u can't fall down in a straight line anymore

notes.title: The Dropper Update!
notes.notes:
This gamemode will get a few more updates because it's lacking content but this is what it is for now!

-Added a new gamemode with 3 levels, the dropper!
-Added 3 new achievements

notes.title: Patch 12/18/2024
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue with people not being able to press a button while in a specific resolution.
- Fixed issue where it would stop people from buying guns in the wave mode.
